s1.desc: a bedroom drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.view: with a yellow bed with duck-topped bedposts between two nightstands with rose-shaded lamps

beats.text: Pax sits up in bed typing on a grey laptop on his lap while Polly sleeps hidden under the blanket beside him
Pax stops typing and glances sideways toward the lump under the blanket
Pax reaches a flipper over and nudges the lump under the blanket
Polly pops her head out from under the blanket holding {ifin} and looks at it while Pax watches her
Polly looks at her phone with her eyes open while Pax sits beside her with the laptop, looking over
Polly closes her eyes and smiles with rosy cheeks over her phone while Pax watches her, the laptop on his lap
Pax pushes the laptop aside and turns toward Polly
Pax wraps his flippers around Polly and hugs her with his eyes closed as a small heart pops up, while she smiles at her phone

spans.notes: the whole skit is one shot with a slow, steady push-in: ECC on the bed band y0.6-0.9 gives scale 1.004-1.011 and 4-17 px per 8 frames, every 8-frame step from f0 to f168 (cc 0.95-0.997 where Pax and Polly are out of the band), no static run; compare 0/169 bed and lamp edges doubled. Polly is only a rose lump under the blanket (top of her head) f0-103, Pax is visible throughout. The laptop lid shows a small igloo logo (Pudgy-world, not a real brand). Polly's phone has the pale grey back, lenses and tuft = iFin (crop f120). No overlay in the top third or bottom fifth | verification pass 2 (verify_v10_report_v15): camera: push_in confirmed. ORB similarity fit every 8 frames gives scale 1.0077-1.0090 per step, centred on (0.50, 0.50), no pan/tilt drift, f0 through f168: a single steady push-in; beat 5 [116,142): Polly's eyes are open only f116-122; from f123 she has her eyes closed with blush and an open-beak smile, so 'gazes at her phone' is false for most of the beat. Split at f123
